recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the FHIR-32351 rename across current build surfaces without changing version migration metadata or legacy CQL examples that still target an older FHIR model.
issue_request: FHIR-32351 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked whether Encounter.period.end could represent a forecast end date and resolved by replacing Encounter.period with Encounter.actualPeriod for actual timing while adding Encounter.plannedStartDate and Encounter.plannedEndDate for planned admission/discharge timing.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by d5986253162e4b14fff3351f2e591f5678e3f91a, which renamed Encounter.period and added planned date elements in Encounter. Merge 748edfcfc0afb39891df4303cbec74996f910276 brought the work into the main history and updated Encounter examples/search parameters. Later FHIR-22765 commit 7ac7c3010e5c7c604804b1a8831b7df36add8a03 clarified Encounter.length as actual but retained a stale Encounter.period reference.
additional_context: FHIR-22766 had originally approved planned admission/discharge extensions, but FHIR-32351 explicitly superseded that extension approach with base Encounter properties. Encounter and Flag are active resources in source/fhir.ini, and source/hierarchy.xml includes clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html in the current page hierarchy. The remaining Encounter.period references after this fix are the intentional fhir.ini old-to-new map and an older-model CQL library declared against legacy FHIR.
reconciliation: Updated current-build prose and example references from Encounter.period to Encounter.actualPeriod in Encounter.length, the matching Encounter event mapping exception, Flag.encounter timing guidance, and the Clinical Reasoning quality-reporting stratifier example.
source_changes: source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml: Updated the Encounter.length comment to compare against Encounter.actualPeriod instead of the removed Encounter.period path.
source/encounter/encounter-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: Kept the Event mapping exception text aligned with the Encounter.length comment.
source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml: Updated Flag.encounter timing guidance to use Encounter.actualPeriod.start/end.
source/clinicalreasoning-quality-reporting.html: Updated the active quality-reporting stratifier example to use Encounter.actualPeriod.
